generic_streaming_bench.note: warm inference medians, release binary, 10 iterations, existing body cache

limits: tiny 40-layer fixture at vocab 67; not a released-checkpoint throughput claim
streamed V4.1 remains checkpoint-I/O bound: 6 routed experts x 40 layers are re-read per decode token
resident decode is host/launch bound; only 2.9 ms per step is GPU dispatch time
generic families keep their resident initial-loading peak and opt-in streaming
full-parameter training offload, Intel Gen9 performance and million-token contexts remain excluded
